# Auralis

> Open-source, on-device push-to-talk dictation for Windows. Hold Ctrl+Space, speak, release; cleaned-up text is typed into the focused app. Speech recognition runs locally on whisper.cpp. No cloud speech-to-text, no telemetry. MIT licensed.

## Pages
- [Home](https://auralis-speak.vercel.app/): what Auralis does, the pipeline, download
- [Playground](https://auralis-speak.vercel.app/playground.html): live dictation in the browser against the Auralis server on your own machine
- [Whitepaper](https://auralis-speak.vercel.app/whitepaper.html): privacy model, pipeline stages, text cleanup rules, local API, measurement and limitations

## Facts
- Shortcuts: Ctrl+Space (hold to talk), Ctrl+Shift+Space (hands-free toggle)
- Pipeline: mic capture (cpal) -> VAD (webrtc-vad) -> denoise (RNNoise) -> STT (whisper.cpp) -> local text cleanup -> keystroke insertion (enigo)
- Default model: base.en (about 59 MB), bundled in the installer (third-party Whisper, interim); small.en (about 190 MB) optional
- Cleanup modes: raw, clean, polished, developer
- Local HTTP API: POST /v1/transcriptions on 127.0.0.1:8787
- Source and releases: https://github.com/Sagexd08/Auralis
